description: Iteration 2 from the best iteration-1 spec (s03): shorten car-following (tau, accel, moto minGap) to cut the 74 m queues and discharge headways; raise red-running and early-start probabilities that stayed far below target; lower right_lane draws; lower jmTimegapMinor of box waiters.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval Table 11 base. Iteration 2: targets M1/car (sim 1.68 s vs obs 0.35 s) and M5/length (sim 74 m vs obs 15.8 m, queues reach the 80 m range in iteration 1): Saval tau 2.5 s / accel 1.2 gives a ~1.7 s discharge headway, so tau 2.5 -> 1.3 s and accel 1.2 -> 2.0 m/s2 shorten the headway and the queue, and also the M6 approach times. decel and minGap kept.

Copy of car_saval so seekers drive like cars apart from the rule. Iteration 2: targets M1/car (sim 1.68 s vs obs 0.35 s) and M5/length (sim 74 m vs obs 15.8 m, queues reach the 80 m range in iteration 1): Saval tau 2.5 s / accel 1.2 gives a ~1.7 s discharge headway, so tau 2.5 -> 1.3 s and accel 1.2 -> 2.0 m/s2 shorten the headway and the queue, and also the M6 approach times. decel and minGap kept.

Saval Table 11 base. Iteration 2: targets M1/moto (sim 0.90 s vs obs 0.30 s), M5/length and M4/overshoot (queues of 74 m): tau 0.8 -> 0.5 s, accel 1.1 -> 3.0 m/s2 and minGap 1.9 -> 1.2 m shorten the discharge headway and the queue. decel and minGapLat kept.

Copy of moto_saval so seekers ride like motorcycles apart from the rule. Iteration 2: targets M1/moto (sim 0.90 s vs obs 0.30 s), M5/length and M4/overshoot (queues of 74 m): tau 0.8 -> 0.5 s, accel 1.1 -> 3.0 m/s2 and minGap 1.9 -> 1.2 m shorten the discharge headway and the queue. decel and minGapLat kept. Share 0.1 kept: M10a is 0.65 vs 0.56 in iteration 1.

Targets M7a/release_time (sim 28.6 s vs obs 2.78 s), M7b/clear_lag (12.5 vs 5.5 s) and M7c/slope: jmTimegapMinor 1.0 -> 0.6 s makes box waiters accept smaller gaps and leave earlier. Same shorter car-following as moto_saval (M1/moto, M6).

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (sim 0.0197 vs obs 0.098, R 7.8) and M3/per_cycle (0.60 vs 3.9): with p0 = 0.2 the share was 0.02, about linear in p0, so p0 = p_max = 0.5 (the Saval front-row value) should bring the share near 0.1. k = 0 kept: M3/var_to_mean 0.96 vs 1.14 is already close.

Targets M2/early/moto (sim 0.016 vs obs 0.130, R 5.2) and M2/first_delay (4.5 vs 2.8 s): p 0.13 gave a share of only 0.016 (21 of 78 attempts ended before crossing), so p -> 0.7; t_before_green 6 -> 10 s and v_max 2 -> 3 m/s let more riders cross before red ends.

Targets M9a/per_cycle (sim 1.39 vs obs 0.57) and M9b/share_blocked (0.22 vs 0.065): p_right_lane 0.2 -> 0.1 halves the right-lane draws. p_sidewalk 0.3 kept (M10a 0.65 vs 0.56; shorter queues will also lower it). p_wrong_lane 0 (inapplicable, R27); q, v_creep, merge_zone_m unchanged.
